# Daily Report — 2026-10-04

## Task Completed
Added `bulk_upload_attachments` tool to `attachment_tools.py`. The tool accepts a list
of up to 50 file items (table_name, table_sys_id, file_name, file_content_base64, optional
content_type and encryption_context) and uploads each file to the ServiceNow
`/api/now/attachment/file` endpoint. Per-item results (success/failure) are returned so
callers can see which files succeeded and which failed without aborting the entire batch.
Registered in the `system_administrator` and `full` tool packages.
